title: Find the actual APN sampler while retaining its missing proof boundary
statement: The delivered completed response reports a polynomial-time distinct-pair sampler for an acquired prefix of a quadratic APN permutation and a candidate-validation theorem. The acquired sampler program and saved report record 1,065 derivative-system checks and an n31 run without enumerating 2^31 inputs.
